title: Why Apple just killed the iPhone

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Hey, did you hear? Apple just made the iPhone irrelevant.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This is huge — it’s changing how we use smartphones forever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They’re replacing the iPhone with a new device called the iPhone 16 Pro Max.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It has a 3D camera that maps your face in real time for AR.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects millions of users who rely on iPhone apps and features.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Apple is betting big on the future of augmented reality.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how this changes everything? Hit follow for the full breakdown.
